comparison: All 128 combinations use identical clean source text, real cached YAKE proposals and current safe contiguous-span grounding. The legacy comparator retains document-global selection grammar only, not the historical unsafe evidence reconstruction.
selection: Choose using the four existing frozen calibration sets only; never inspect fresh predictions before this choice is frozen.

Require each calibration set's existing numeric precision/recall floors and no more YAKE empty-case labels than the legacy policy in any set. Existing empty-case failures stay failed and visible; this does not waive their delivery gate.

Require all existing no-argument known-answer selection/grammar regression functions listed in frozen_contract_functions to pass unchanged; report their failures for every ablation. This is contract evidence, distinct from independent quality evidence.

Among eligible policies minimize enabled-rule count, then prefer no grammar dependency, then no handwritten predicate penalty; break remaining ties by worst-set precision, worst-set recall and stable policy name.
If no policy qualifies, retain the previous production policy and report that simplification failed; do not lower thresholds or alter old gold.

Freeze the selected policy and calibration receipt in a commit before evaluating the fresh set. Evaluate only selected, clean-YAKE and legacy comparators there; do not tune after viewing fresh results.

boilerplate_tradeoff.structural: Configured exclusions and non-prose/metadata syntax are hard boundaries; truly empty visible text must produce zero topics.
boilerplate_tradeoff.protected_subjects: An empty child field or an unrelated unanswered prompt must not make an otherwise eligible substantive parent caption or filled-field subject ineligible.
boilerplate_tradeoff.ambiguity: Blank colon fields, list shape and repetition alone do not justify suppressing a nominal subject. Prefer retaining uncertain observed wording to silently erasing a substantive outline; report resulting prompt noise explicitly.
boilerplate_tradeoff.measurement: Report unused forms, substantive outlines and partially completed forms separately with every assigned label. Diagnostic contrast cases are not independent holdout evidence.
boilerplate_tradeoff.unchanged_delivery_gate: The existing LYT unused-form zero-false-topic gate remains unchanged; documented ambiguity is not a pass.

fresh_evaluation.annotators: Two independent source-only models plus a third source-only adjudicator; no implementation or extractor output inspected.
fresh_evaluation.underspecified_cases: Keep all predictions visible and report their judgments separately; do not silently classify or drop them to improve macro metrics.
fresh_evaluation.limits: Sixteen held-out notes from the same authored LYT mirror, not a different-vault or human-reviewed generalization claim. Exact observed-label scoring remains a proxy.

calibration_revisions.outcome: No eligible local policy: unused-form labels grew from one to five. All numeric floors and old selection regressions passed for local-full.

changes: Colon-followed candidates bypass isolated-subject/nominal-context shortcuts and use the existing POS rules; this is fallible relevance, not metadata masking.
Every provenance must have a safe contiguous visible evidence span; masked syntax/content cannot be reconstructed into stored evidence.
Extra grammatical subject-field counterexamples are reported as diagnostic costs, with no change to the four frozen gold sets or acceptance floors.
